# Underground laboratory presentation slice

Base: 99077c0b804b5cd906221546907be15fa1e604c4 (WalletConnect integrated). Risk R0 presentation only. Next 16.3.4 / React 19.2.6 / ethers 5.8.0. Existing protected deployment fbf2910; WalletConnect critical builder separately owns the root checkout. This isolated worktree is the sole theme source lane. Preserve the walletControls flex wrapper and wallet-provider integration from this base.

## Scope and ownership
A presentation worker owns LabHero.tsx, LabHero.module.css, globals.css, CSS modules for launch/workspace/guides and the new optimized public/images/hoodlabs-underground-lab.webp asset. Root supplies generated artwork, integrates after WalletConnect, and owns final build/browser/deployment evidence. No dependency, financial handler, provider, authentication, Pro threshold, pricing, security copy, page route or gate edits. Do not edit PonsLaunchpad.tsx or ProAccess.tsx because WalletConnect owns them. No worker subagents.

## Design
Create a materially distinct, premium underground/traphouse laboratory: battered concrete, workbench instruments, blackletter wordmark, distressed tape labels, stencil-like Anton headings, bone-white text, acid #ccff00 accents, controlled scan/signal motion. Keep existing local fonts. Hero uses root-provided photographic workshop asset and an accessible HTML equipment-readout overlay. Use texture and distress outside forms. Inputs, balances, addresses, fees and warnings remain flat, legible and unchanged. No fabricated live metrics, status badges or safety claims. Preserve clear Launch/Plan/Pro links, motion pause and prefers-reduced-motion; decorative instrumentation is aria-hidden.

## Acceptance
- Material visual update to hero, page shell, instrument panels and guides; navigation and existing link targets remain intact.
- Readable 16px input text, minimum44px controls, visible keyboard focus, no body overflow at375/768/1440px. No fast flashes; all continuous motion pauseable/reduced-motion compliant.
- Price US$15 and inclusive666666 RICH requirement, live-disabled/protected state, custody/signing and eligibility semantics unchanged.
- New hero optimized WebP under450KB with dimensions; no new external runtime scripts/fonts/tracking/dependencies.
- Worker edit/check loop, combined exact revision typecheck/tests/build/scans/audit, browser screenshots/keyboard/mobile/reduced-motion checks, fresh final release review, CI and protected hosted check before publishing completion.

| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Distress hides transaction details | Medium | Decorate outer panels; flat readable controls and semantic errors |
| Mobile hero crowds wallet controls | Medium | Responsive stacked hero, no viewport overflow,44px targets |
| Motion causes discomfort | Medium | No rapid flicker; existing pause and reduced-motion apply |
| Parallel authority edits conflict | Low | Isolated worktree; CSS/hero scope only; root integrates after provider work |

Key principle: make the room feel underground while keeping every financial action unambiguous.
